description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature that can hear and understand you

Duration varies

Saving Throw Will

Speak a single command. The target must attempt a Will save against your class DC. On a failure it obeys for 1 round; on a critical failure, for 1 minute, and it may not attempt to end the effect early. On a success it is stunned 1 as the voice lands anyway. A creature that worships your patron, or that the GM judges to be desperate, takes a -2 circumstance penalty to this save. This is an auditory, emotion, linguistic, and mental effect. A target that obeys and survives remembers exactly whose voice it was.
